positioning: CountScope is a broader photo-counting brand. Its current automatic mode remains focused on exposed skewer ends; users review the entire photo, correct markers and keep local records. implementationDecisions: Rename to the user-requested broader CountScope brand; preserve bundle ID and stable support/privacy URLs.
Use generic marker-review and saved-count workflow in subtitle; describe exposed skewer ends as the current automatic mode in the first sentence.
Retain three authentic screenshot benefits: reference area and full-photo review, manual corrections, local records. Recapture Build 4 after UI rename and billing changes.
Introduce four free completed automatic counts, optional monthly subscription and Apple-eligible seven-day trial as distinct concepts.
Do not place time/price/accuracy promises in keyword fields. Avoid rival brand names and unimplemented pipe/colony/general recognition.
